# Shared assets route, bundled fonts and highlight.js, and theme.css on both pages

## What to build

Both web pages are single self-contained HTML files today, with copied CSS and JS:

- the single-run page `src/web/page.html` (served by `src/web/server.ts`)
- the suite page `src/suite/page.html` (served by `src/suite/server.ts`)

This slice lays the foundation for sharing code between them, and switches both pages to the new dark "mission control" theme tokens.

1. A new static route `GET /assets/<path>` on both servers, serving files from `src/web/assets/` (`dist/web/assets/` after a build). It uses a shared helper in a new `src/web/assets.ts`.
2. `postbuild` copies `src/web/assets/` to `dist/web/assets/`.
3. Bundled third-party files under `src/web/assets/vendor/`, so the UI works offline and over SSH tunnels with no CDN:
   - highlight.js 11 (ES module build plus about 15 languages)
   - Inter and JetBrains Mono woff2 fonts
   - their licence files
4. `src/web/assets/theme.css`: the dark-only design tokens, the `@font-face` rules and the base element styles.
   - Both pages link it and drop their own `:root` token blocks.
   - The run page also drops its light theme and its `prefers-color-scheme` block.
   - The pages' existing class names keep working, because the token names stay the same and new ones are only added.
5. Tooling for browser JS modules: `allowJs` in `tsconfig.json` so vitest/tsc tests can import `src/web/assets/*.js`, and an eslint block for those files.

Nothing else changes visually beyond colours and fonts. Later slices build the layout, graph, panel and diff viewer on top of this.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `src/web/server.ts`:
  - L89: `pageFile` default `new URL("./page.html", import.meta.url)`
  - L121–128: the `Route` type, the `json()` helper, and `"GET /"` (read the file, `content-type: text/html; charset=utf-8`, `cache-control: no-store`)
  - L365–415: `handle()`. The Host check (421) and the Origin check (403) come first, then the prefix routes, then `routes[\`${method} ${pathname}\`]`, then the 404/405 fallback, which uses a `known` list at L413.
- `src/suite/server.ts`:
  - L93: `pageFile`, set with `fileURLToPath(new URL("./page.html", import.meta.url))`
  - L256–289: `handle()`. Its `allowedMethod` (L281–284) returns 404 for anything not listed, so `/assets/*` must be dispatched before that check.
- `src/web/page.html`:
  - L8–24: light `:root` tokens, then dark tokens under `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)`
  - L25–26: base styles (`font: 14px ui-monospace…`)
- `src/suite/page.html` L8–18: its dark-only tokens. Both pages use `--bg --panel --text --muted --faint --accent --accent2 --ok --warn --bad --validating`, `--diff-add/-gutter/-mark`, `--diff-del*`, `--diff-hunk*` and `--syn-comment/string/keyword/number`.
- `package.json`: the L35 `postbuild` script.
- `tsconfig.json`: no `allowJs`, `include` covers only ts/tsx. `eslint.config.js` (10 lines): `js.configs.recommended` would apply `no-undef` to `.js` files, and no browser globals are configured.
- `src/web/server.test.ts`:
  - L12–31: `setup()` (`RunEmitter`, `RunStore`, `createWebServer({store, meta, onAbort, onClose})`)
  - L120–127: the page test
- `src/suite/server.test.ts` L29–86: `setup()`, which writes its own `page.html` and calls `createSuiteServer`.

## Patterns to follow

**Shared helper `src/web/assets.ts`:**
```ts
import type http from "node:http";
import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

export const ASSETS_DIR = fileURLToPath(new URL("./assets/", import.meta.url));
const TYPES: Record<string, string> = {
  ".js": "text/javascript; charset=utf-8", ".css": "text/css; charset=utf-8", ".woff2": "font/woff2",
  ".svg": "image/svg+xml", ".json": "application/json", ".txt": "text/plain; charset=utf-8",
};

/** Serves GET /assets/<path> from `root`; false when it is not a servable asset (the caller answers 404). */
export async function serveAsset(root: string, pathname: string, res: http.ServerResponse): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!pathname.startsWith("/assets/")) return false;
  let rel: string;
  try { rel = decodeURIComponent(pathname.slice("/assets/".length)); } catch { return false; }
  const base = path.resolve(root);
  const file = path.resolve(base, rel);
  const type = TYPES[path.extname(file)];
  if (!type || !file.startsWith(base + path.sep)) return false;
  try {
    res.writeHead(200, { "content-type": type, "cache-control": "no-cache" }).end(await readFile(file));
    return true;
  } catch { return false; }
}
```

**Wiring:**
- Run server, in `handle()` after the Host/Origin guards and before the prefix routes:
  ```ts
  if (pathname.startsWith("/assets/")) {
    if (req.method !== "GET") return void res.writeHead(405).end("Method Not Allowed");
    if (!(await serveAsset(ASSETS_DIR, pathname, res))) res.writeHead(404).end("Not Found");
    return;
  }
  ```
- Suite server: the same, before `allowedMethod`, with `fileURLToPath(new URL("../web/assets/", import.meta.url))` as the root.

**Browser modules convention** (later slices rely on it):
- plain ES2022 modules with `// @ts-check` on line 1 and JSDoc types
- pure functions exported first, DOM code after
- tests are `src/web/assets/*.test.ts` and import `./x.js`

## Step-by-step tasks

### CREATE `src/web/assets.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: the helper above.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx tsc --noEmit`

### UPDATE `src/web/server.ts` and `src/suite/server.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: the wiring above.
- **GOTCHA**: the guards (Host 421, foreign Origin 403 on non-GET) must still run first.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/web/server src/suite/server`

### CREATE `src/web/assets/vendor/` (bundled files)

- **IMPLEMENT**: fetch the npm packages without adding dependencies, using `npm pack` into a temp dir and extracting there.
  - highlight.js:
    1. Run `npm pack @highlightjs/cdn-assets@11.12.0` and copy `es/highlight.min.js` to `src/web/assets/vendor/highlight/highlight.min.js`.
    2. Copy `es/languages/{typescript,javascript,json,python,go,rust,java,css,scss,xml,bash,markdown,yaml,sql,diff}.min.js` to `vendor/highlight/languages/`.
    3. Copy `LICENSE` to `vendor/highlight/LICENSE`.
  - Fonts: `npm pack @fontsource/inter@5.3.0` and `@fontsource/jetbrains-mono@5.3.0`. Copy the latin `*-latin-{400,500,600}-normal.woff2` files to `vendor/fonts/` and each package's `LICENSE` as `vendor/fonts/Inter-LICENSE.txt` and `vendor/fonts/JetBrainsMono-LICENSE.txt`.
  - Create `src/web/assets/vendor/README.md` that lists each file's source package and version.
- **GOTCHA**:
  - Do **not** add these packages to `package.json`.
  - Keep the total under 600 KB.
  - Check that the ES-module language files `import`/export the way `highlight.min.js` expects: in cdn-assets `es/`, each language file `export default` a grammar to pass to `hljs.registerLanguage(name, grammar)`.
- **VALIDATE**: `du -sh src/web/assets/vendor`

### CREATE `src/web/assets/theme.css`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - `@font-face` for Inter (400/500/600) and JetBrains Mono (400/500), with `url("/assets/vendor/fonts/…woff2")` and `font-display: swap`.
  - `:root { color-scheme: dark; … }` with all the existing token names, set to these values:
    - `--bg: #07090d`, `--panel: rgba(17,21,28,.72)`, `--panel-solid: #0f131a`, `--border: rgba(148,163,184,.14)`
    - `--text: #e6edf3`, `--muted: #8b98a9`, `--faint: #4b5563`
    - `--accent: #5eead4`, `--accent2: #a78bfa`, `--ok: #34d399`, `--warn: #fbbf24`, `--bad: #f87171`, `--validating: #fbbf24`
    - diff tokens: GitHub-dark-like
  - New tokens: `--glow: 0 0 0 1px var(--border), 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.45)`, `--radius: 10px`, `--blur: blur(14px) saturate(140%)`, `--font-ui: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif`, `--font-code: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace`.
  - Base styles: `html, body { background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font: 13px/1.5 var(--font-ui); }`, `code, pre, .mono { font-family: var(--font-code); }`, buttons with the `.btn` look (glass, border, hover glow), scrollbars styled thin.
  - `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; } }`
- **VALIDATE**: `curl` the asset after a build (below).

### UPDATE `src/web/page.html` and `src/suite/page.html`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - add `<link rel="stylesheet" href="/assets/theme.css">` in `<head>` before the inline `<style>`
  - delete each page's `:root` token blocks and the run page's dark-mode media query
  - change the body font rules to use `var(--font-ui)`, and code/diff rules to use `var(--font-code)`
- **GOTCHA**: some inline rules use the colours directly. Search for hex colours in both `<style>` blocks and switch them to tokens where a token exists.
- **VALIDATE**: build, then look at both pages with agent-browser (TESTING.md "Web view").

### UPDATE `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `eslint.config.js`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - `package.json`: in `postbuild`'s second `node -e` script, append `;fs.cpSync('src/web/assets','dist/web/assets',{recursive:true})`
  - `tsconfig.json`: add `"allowJs": true` to `compilerOptions`, without `checkJs`
  - `eslint.config.js`: add `"src/web/assets/vendor/"` to `ignores`, and a block `{ files: ["src/web/assets/**/*.js"], rules: { "no-undef": "off" } }`
- **VALIDATE**: `npm run build && ls dist/web/assets/theme.css dist/web/assets/vendor/highlight/highlight.min.js && npx eslint .`

### UPDATE tests

- `src/web/server.test.ts`:
  - `GET /assets/theme.css` → 200 `text/css; charset=utf-8`
  - `GET /assets/vendor/highlight/highlight.min.js` → 200 `text/javascript`
  - `GET /assets/../server.ts`, `/assets/%2e%2e/server.ts` and `/assets/nope.css` → 404
  - `POST /assets/theme.css` with a same-origin header → 405
  - `/assets/x.exe` → 404
- `src/suite/server.test.ts`: `GET /assets/theme.css` → 200, and traversal → 404.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/web/server src/suite/server`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `GET /assets/<file>` serves files from the assets dir on both servers with the right content type and `cache-control: no-cache`
- [ ] Traversal and unknown extensions → 404, and non-GET → 405
- [ ] `npm run build` copies the assets, and `node dist/cli.js … --web` serves `/assets/theme.css`
- [ ] highlight.js (with the 15 languages) and the Inter and JetBrains Mono fonts are bundled with their licences, under 600 KB, and no new `package.json` dependencies were added
- [ ] Both pages load `theme.css` and render dark, with Inter for the UI and JetBrains Mono for code; nothing is broken (graph, panel, diff and review still work)
- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit && npx eslint . && npm test` pass
- [ ] Agent-browser screenshots of both pages are in the report

## Validation commands

```bash
npx tsc --noEmit && npx eslint .
npx vitest run src/web/server src/suite/server
npm run build && ls -R dist/web/assets | head
# TESTING.md "Web view" with agent-browser; also the suite page (demo/suite/run.sh)
```
